scope: Actual four-image review of static adoption, dynamic initial load/return, and deliberate corrupted-index fallback.

findings.observation: On return, a rectangular baseline building appears through/above the detailed tile roof and occludes both storeys of doors/windows. Projecting rails, columns and lions remain in front. The initial dynamic load did not show this overlap.
findings.technical_audit_limitation: CPU owner counts, mask data and near-group visibility passed; these alone did not prove the final GPU-rendered far building was suppressed.

findings.observation: With the deliberately corrupted macro index, the baseline three-storey inferred building remains and no detailed target is loaded.

next_action: Diagnose and fix rebind/disposal shader uniform lifecycle, then rerun actual catalog load/unload/return and inspect returned-frame output. Preserve this first-run evidence.
